pn-pairs.label: Distinct LSG batting pairs, 2022–2026
pn-pairs.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
pn-pairs.query: SELECT CASE WHEN b.name < n.name THEN b.name ELSE n.name END p1, CASE WHEN b.name < n.name THEN n.name ELSE b.name END p2, SUM(d.total_runs) runs, SUM(CASE WHEN (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) balls FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id JOIN players b ON b.player_id = d.batter_id JOIN players n ON n.player_id = d.non_striker_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND i.batting_team_id IN (13) AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2022 AND 2026 GROUP BY p1, p2
